2577-4063-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-4063-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3534-8098.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Mountain Valley.
[
1479-2841-3534-8098.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3534-8098.description:
Fetch a land using Mountain Valley.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-3899-6273.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5231-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5231-5477.description:
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2733-4050-5043-7824.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1368-4478-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4478-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2523-2869-3195.description:
Activate Dromar's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Dromar's Attendant dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Dromar's Attendant that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Dromar's Attendant token

1445-4871-5147-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5147-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1409-3128-5184.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve the Skullport Merchant trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2440-3581-5295-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-5295-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

1651-2638-5967-6751-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2638-5967-6751-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2638-5967-6751-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1350-2793-5412-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

372-1031-2417.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1031-2417.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Invasion of Arcavios and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Invasion of Arcavios trigger.
Resolve the Invasion of Arcavios trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Invasion of Arcavios and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

585-2097-4508-5880.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-1374-5499-6791--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-5499-6791--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

1323-3043-4687.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
1323-3043-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Axebane Guardian's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1231-2511-4826-6644.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

570-2608-4050.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-2608-4050.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Derevi, adding {1}.
Choose to have Derevi return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting Derevi onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Derevi enters the battlefield, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.

3693-4396-5220.description:
Cast Walking Ballista either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Walking Ballista on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1723-2512-4594.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Starlit Sanctum's second ability by paying {W}, tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

112-3075-5115.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three experience counters.
Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter on it.
112-3075-5115.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U}, putting a charge counter on Gemstone Array and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

14-147-2034.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1309-1987-3075-3448.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1309-1987-3075-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
